_readme.description: Manual mapping file for quest rewards
_readme.format: Map reward script names from GdsQuestRewards.lua to quest IDs
_readme.usage: Fill in the 'quest_id' field for each reward entry
workflow: 1. Look at the reward name and associated data (XP, items, comment)
2. Search for matching quest in the CFF editor or database
4. The parser will use these manual mappings when loading data
_readme.note: Comments from the original file are included to help with identification
